messages:
leigh: Quick sync follow-up: we need a concrete, low-cardinality telemetry contract for hosted/dedicated/private handoffs. I sketched enums + header names. Keeping it small to avoid metric explosion.

sam: Agree. Metrics must use fixed enums. Traces can carry full model names only when sampled & allowed.

maria: Proposed tag set: hosting_mode=HOSTED|DEDICATED|PRIVATE, route_path=PREFERRED|FALLBACK|DEGRADED, variant_bucket=perf|balanced|accurate, fallback_reason=none|capacity|model_mismatch|auth|quota, routing_version=v1|v2|v3.

oliver (sec): No raw tenant ids in hosted metrics. Private deployments may include tenant context but only into customer-controlled audit sinks. Any trace sampling that captures payloads must be explicit opt-in.

sam: Header propagation idea so adapters keep tags across handoffs. Draft headers:
X-RW-Hosting-Mode: DEDICATED
X-RW-Route-Path: FALLBACK
X-RW-Variant-Bucket: perf
X-RW-Routing-Version: v2
X-RW-Fallback-Reason: capacity
X-RW-Telemetry-Sample: 1/200

maria: Runtime maintains mapping table model_name -> variant_bucket to avoid shipping model names as tags. New models map to 'other' until reviewed.

leigh: Migration plan notes: runtime emits defaults (UNKNOWN,PREFERRED,balanced,none); adapters override. Dashboards migrate to redwood.request.latency_ms{hosting_mode,route_path,variant_bucket}. Exporter should canonicalize unexpected tag values to "other" and emit an alert.

oliver (sec): I'll draft the telemetry policy blurb (metrics vs audit sinks, sampling opt-in, retention TTL for sampled traces = 30d).

ops-bot: Reminder: runtime deploy window Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Tag @sam if you want it.

sam: I'll take it and open PR for header emit + mapping API.

leigh: Action items: leigh update RFC with schema + headers; sam PR + tests; maria mapping table API; oliver policy text. I'll post RFC patch tomorrow.
